scope: Star candidate input preparation only, frozen before candidate selection; no LP2 matching authorized
catalogue: CDS V/50/catalog complete VizieR TSV. NASA retained as provenance mirror, not merged.
nonstellar: Explicitly exclude HR92,95,182,1057,1841,2472,2496,3515,3671,6309,6515,7189,7539,8296, the14 nonstellar retained-number entries identified by catalogue documentation. Also exclude any missing/unparseable/nonfiniteJ2000RA/Dec orVmag; log every row.
photometry: Source Vmag visual value, flags retained but not silently excluded; no magnitude epoch, variability selection or colour cut. Rank ascending (Vmag,integerHR), exactly5 perconstellation.
membership: Astropy8.0.2 get_constellation(SkyCoord(FK5(equinox=J2000), catalogueJ2000positions),short_name=True); Roman1987 IAU boundaries with B1875precession insidepinnedlibrary. No manualBayer/Flamsteed suffix membership. Disable IERS downloads. No propermotion or epoch tuning.
duplicates: Each distinctHR record retained, including binary/multiple components and coincident/nearcoincident coordinates. No angular merge, flux combination or handreplacement; record closepairs and flags so fivecataloguerecords is not represented as fiveunresolvedvisualsources.
projection: One J2000gnomonic plane perselectedfive, centred on normalized unweighted mean ofJ2000unitvectors. East/north basis fromcentreRA/Dec; x=(v·east)/(v·centre),y=(v·north)/(v·centre). Stop before matching if centreundefined,anydenominator<=0,orzeroRMSradius. No centreoptimization.
validation: Requireall88 official shortnames andatleast5 eligible rows each. Exact installedRoman/names files must match recoveredtaggedsource bytes. Candidate lists/projections are fixed inputs to later reviewedmatchingplan, not outcomes.
